purpose: Define the types, properties, relations, projections, and constraint operators an implementation-conformance engine can use to understand an architecture.

execution_model.comparison: constraint evaluation over typed properties and relations
execution_model.result: explainable findings with expected and observed values
execution_model.forbidden_shortcut: folder, filename, syntax, or tool result must not create semantic identity or authority

source_refs.use: node identity, role, owner, status, challenge, and forbidden-collapse fields
directed endpoint, evidence, authority-effect, value-effect, and cycle-policy fields
read-model projection inputs, allowed use, blocked use, drift owner, and review trigger
canonical DS-D1 identity, category, maturity, criteria, deferred state, and superseded tombstone
plain-language projection copy and authority boundary context
local contract for property evaluation, profile composition, observations, and TypeScript, Python, and Rust candidate realizations
local contract for architecture types, property families, relations, mappings, and authority boundaries
candidate-local W4 State Machine and Workflow semantics, implementation order, language forms, and authority ceiling
owner-selected portable Enum boundary and exact TypeScript, Python, and Rust protocol forms
owner-authored candidate-fixture member keys and wire values that implementations may observe but never define
owner-selected descriptor-bound pure-value Calculation architecture and TypeScript, Python, and Rust candidate protocols
owner-selected descriptor-bound effect-free Policy strategy selection architecture and TypeScript, Python, and Rust candidate protocols
owner-selected descriptor-bound fully observed read-only Query architecture and TypeScript, Python, and Rust candidate protocols
owner-selected immutable complete-tuple Value Object architecture, additive-validator-only factory extension, and TypeScript, Python, and Rust candidate protocols
owner-selected stable-identity immutable Entity snapshots, capability-owned construction routes, additive factory extension, and TypeScript, Python, and Rust candidate protocols

concept_types.label: Architecture Element

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: profile owner review plus discriminating fixture

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: An architecture element is not automatically a DomainSpec concept or source file.

concept_types.label: Domain Concept Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact binding fixture and profile owner review

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: Implementation shape does not establish DomainSpec identity, formation, or admission.

concept_types.label: Enum Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact reciprocal DS-D1.3 binding, owner-authored catalogue, selected native protocol, explicit wire boundary, and non-collapse fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A finite-looking constant set is not necessarily an admitted DomainSpec Enum, Value Object, or State Machine.

concept_types.label: Enum Representation Unit
concept_types.owner_route: Enum realization profile plus language adapter owner

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact member provenance plus acyclic composition fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A representation unit is implementation evidence only; it is not a DomainSpec Enum, canonical value set, module, or source-file identity.

concept_types.label: Rule Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: positive and negative Rule source-shape fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A boolean-looking callable is not necessarily an admitted DomainSpec Rule.

concept_types.label: Operation Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: binding and dependency fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A use-case folder does not mint a new DomainSpec UseCase meta-type.

concept_types.label: Query Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact descriptor/provider binding, every declared read and no undeclared read, exact fully consumed output, independently observed zero writes through quiescence, and fail-closed unsupported channels

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: Source location, a before-and-after snapshot, or an initially returned value does not prove read-only behavior through complete result consumption.

concept_types.label: State Machine Implementation
concept_types.owner_route: State Machine profile plus application runtime owner

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: supported-profile admission plus static and runtime fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: Static exhaustiveness is not runtime transition correctness or effect delivery.

concept_types.label: State Contract

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: closed-state and transition fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A state value is supporting graph evidence; it is not independently a DomainSpec State Machine.

concept_types.label: Workflow Implementation
concept_types.owner_route: Workflow profile plus application runtime owner

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact step graph, outcome, failure, compensation, and continuation fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A call sequence is not a Workflow unless it binds the authored step graph and its failure semantics.

concept_types.label: Workflow Step Contract

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact binding, ordering, and compensation fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A function call is supporting step evidence; it does not author Workflow membership or order.

concept_types.label: Data Shape Contract

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: content-addressed shape contract plus Mapping endpoint fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A native data type does not author a DomainSpec Mapping endpoint or field correspondence.

concept_types.label: Mapping Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact source, target, correspondence, effect, failure, and reverse fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A conversion-looking function or interface declaration does not author Mapping meaning.

concept_types.label: Event Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: past-fact payload, occurrence, consumer, and exactly-one durable checkpoint fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A record, class, or emitted call does not author Event meaning or a distributed exactly-once guarantee.

concept_types.label: Interface Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: version and direction fixtures plus profile admission

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: An interface declaration does not prove adapter behavior.

concept_types.label: Adapter Implementation
concept_types.owner_route: architecture provider and project adapter owner

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: inward-dependency and interface fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: An adapters folder does not prove interface conformance or inward dependency.

concept_types.label: Architecture Profile

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: profile schema and mutation fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A candidate profile is not an admitted semantic profile or universal architecture.

concept_types.label: Architecture Constraint

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: positive and negative operator fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A constraint is an expected property assertion, not an observed fact or authority verdict.

concept_types.label: Language Projection

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: native parser/compiler fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A language projection observes architecture properties; it does not define their portable meaning.

concept_types.label: Observed Architecture Fact Projection

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: source digest and adapter replay

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: Extracted facts are digest-bound evidence, not canonical source or semantic identity.

concept_types.label: Calculation Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact descriptor/provider binding, deterministic repeated value, independently observed zero forbidden reads and writes, complete result consumption, and hostile nondeterminism/effect controls

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: An arrow function, pure-looking expression, or returned value does not establish an admitted DomainSpec Calculation.

concept_types.label: Policy Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact descriptor/provider/strategy-catalogue binding, input-sensitive selection of one current member identity, independently observed zero reads, writes, and strategy execution, plus hostile boolean, membership, drift, and effect controls

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A boolean decision, valid-looking executable object, strategy membership record, or selected strategy execution does not establish an admitted DomainSpec Policy.

concept_types.label: Policy Strategy Contract

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: a non-empty content-addressed owner catalogue proves exact strategy identities and current membership independently from selection and execution

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A callable shape, stable catalogue identifier, or executable object cannot author or prove current strategy membership.

concept_types.label: Value Object Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact complete normalized tuple, same-tuple equality and hashing, recursive owned-component immutability, validation before formation, and additive-validator-only factory extension

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: Readonly syntax, reference identity, serialization bytes, a hash collision, or a native record shape does not establish an admitted DomainSpec Value Object.

concept_types.label: Value Object Factory Provider

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact factory-definition validator identities, base-before-extension order, structured failure without formation, immutable construction, and an acyclic additive-validation-only extension chain

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A factory provider is implementation support, not a canonical DomainSpec meta-type, concept identity, or authority source.

concept_types.label: Entity Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: at least one typed stable identity component, identity-only equality and hashing across immutable lifecycle snapshots, owner-bound validation before identity resolution and construction, and complete capability-owned construction-route coverage

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: Object reference, pointer identity, complete-field equality, a mutable class, or a record with an id field does not establish an admitted DomainSpec Entity.

concept_types.label: Entity Factory Provider

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: every admitted factory, reconstruction, lifecycle-transition, and language-visible constructor route converges on exact base-before-extension validation, stable identity resolution, immutable construction, and an acyclic additive-only extension chain

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A constructor, deserializer, subclass, or factory function is implementation support, not a canonical DomainSpec meta-type, identity authority, or permission to bypass validation.

property_definitions.label: Source language
property_definitions.semantics: Language whose adapter produced the observed fact.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Language does not select semantic identity.

property_definitions.label: Source path
property_definitions.semantics: Repository-relative source-unit path observed under a profile.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Path never establishes concept identity.

property_definitions.label: Filename case convention
property_definitions.semantics: Observed filename naming convention.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Naming style is not concept identity or behavior.

property_definitions.label: Realization protocol identifier
property_definitions.semantics: Stable identifier of the profile-selected protocol used to realize and observe an architecture element.
property_definitions.owner_route: architecture profile owner plus language adapter owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A matching protocol identifier does not prove semantic identity, correct implementation, or runtime behavior.

property_definitions.label: Runtime provider digest
property_definitions.semantics: SHA-256 digest of the exact runtime provider bytes admitted by the selected architecture profile.
property_definitions.observation_stage: profile binding plus runtime provider hashing
property_definitions.owner_route: architecture profile owner plus runtime provider owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Digest equality proves byte identity only; it does not prove domain meaning, conformance, safety, or production admission.

property_definitions.label: Primary bound concepts per source unit
property_definitions.semantics: Number of primary DomainSpec implementation bindings owned by the source unit.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A count cannot establish which concept is bound.

property_definitions.label: Canonical concept identifier
property_definitions.semantics: Exact owner-resolved DomainSpec concept identifier associated with the implementation.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: The ontology and folder layout cannot mint this identifier.

property_definitions.label: Binding freshness
property_definitions.semantics: Whether mapping, source, profile, and projection digests reconcile exactly.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A stale binding cannot be repaired by filename similarity.

property_definitions.label: Primary callable entry points
property_definitions.semantics: Number of callables selected as the primary realization of the bound concept.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Primary-callable cardinality does not prove semantic correctness.

property_definitions.label: Public or exported callables
property_definitions.semantics: Language-native count of exported or public callable symbols in the source unit.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Export semantics are language-specific and cannot be normalized by name alone.

property_definitions.label: Callable syntax form
property_definitions.semantics: Language-native syntactic form of the primary callable.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Callable syntax does not define Rule meaning.

property_definitions.label: Callable return semantics
property_definitions.semantics: Profile-declared behavioral return category corroborated by native evidence.
property_definitions.owner_route: DomainSpec definition owner plus language adapter owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A return type alone cannot admit or classify a DomainSpec concept.

property_definitions.label: Helper composition policy
property_definitions.semantics: Whether and where supporting implementation helpers may exist.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Helper policy must not become an implicit one-export rule.

property_definitions.label: Dependency target resolution
property_definitions.semantics: How the observed dependency resolves to its exact target.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Reachability through a barrel does not prove exact target identity.

property_definitions.label: Dependency layer direction
property_definitions.semantics: Direction of a dependency relative to the selected layer model.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: File import direction is not business relationship direction.

property_definitions.label: State representation form
property_definitions.semantics: Native representation selected for the admitted State Machine states.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Representation form does not prove transition behavior.

property_definitions.label: Static state exhaustiveness
property_definitions.semantics: Whether native type/compiler evidence covers all admitted states.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Static exhaustiveness does not prove invalid transitions are rejected.

property_definitions.label: Negative transition fixture
property_definitions.semantics: Whether an application-owned fixture exercises a named invalid transition.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Fixture presence does not prove production effect delivery.

property_definitions.label: Closed state-set contract
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed identity of the complete admitted state set.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Native enum or union members cannot author the state set.

property_definitions.label: Initial state contract
property_definitions.semantics: Exact initial state identity declared by the State Machine.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Constructor defaults cannot author the semantic initial state.

property_definitions.label: Terminal states contract
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed identities of terminal states.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus hostile transition observation
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A state without outgoing code branches is not automatically terminal.

property_definitions.label: Transition trigger
property_definitions.semantics: Exact trigger selecting one directed transition.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A method name cannot author the trigger.

property_definitions.label: Transition guard bindings
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed ordered Rule bindings required by a transition.
property_definitions.owner_route: State Machine and Rule binding owners
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A condition branch cannot author a semantic guard edge.

property_definitions.label: Transition effect intents
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed ordered effect intents returned by the pure transition decision for Operation execution.
property_definitions.observation_stage: transition output plus Operation effect observation
property_definitions.owner_route: State Machine and Operation descriptor owners
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Returning an intent does not prove its execution or delivery.

property_definitions.label: Invalid transition policy
property_definitions.semantics: Required behavior for any undeclared source-trigger pair.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Exhaustive types do not prove invalid runtime transitions reject.

property_definitions.label: Transition effect execution boundary
property_definitions.semantics: The State Machine returns effect intents and performs no inline I/O; Operations execute the intents.
property_definitions.observation_stage: provider contract plus hostile effect observation
property_definitions.owner_route: State Machine and Operation provider owners
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A pure-looking signature does not prove absence of hidden effects.

property_definitions.label: Workflow scope
property_definitions.semantics: Declared boundary within which the Workflow coordinates steps.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Folder reach does not author orchestration scope.

property_definitions.label: Workflow step order
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed exact order of declared steps.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Call graph reachability does not prove order.

property_definitions.label: Workflow terminal outcomes
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed complete terminal outcome vocabulary.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A return value cannot author all valid terminal outcomes.

property_definitions.label: Workflow failure contract
property_definitions.semantics: Exact failure behavior contract for the orchestration.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus hostile failure fixture
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Catching an exception does not author failure semantics.

property_definitions.label: Workflow continuation boundary
property_definitions.semantics: Point after which workflow observation is complete.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A returned promise does not prove all work was observed.

property_definitions.label: Workflow step identity
property_definitions.semantics: Stable step identity within one Workflow descriptor.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A function name cannot author step identity.

property_definitions.label: Workflow step failure policy
property_definitions.semantics: Behavior selected when the bound step fails.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus hostile failure fixture
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Exception syntax does not establish stop, continue, or compensate policy.

property_definitions.label: Workflow step compensation
property_definitions.semantics: Exact compensation Operation required when failure policy is compensate.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus reverse-order compensation trace
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A cleanup function is not a declared compensation contract.

property_definitions.label: Versioned interface contract
property_definitions.semantics: Whether the implementation boundary binds an explicit supported contract version.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A version field does not prove adapter correctness.

property_definitions.label: Mapping source contract
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed identity of the authored source shape.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A parameter type cannot author the source endpoint.

property_definitions.label: Mapping target contract
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed identity of the authored target shape.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A return type cannot author the target endpoint.

property_definitions.label: Mapping direction
property_definitions.semantics: Authored direction of the correspondence.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Call direction cannot mint semantic direction.

property_definitions.label: Mapping field correspondence
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed direct, ignored, synthesized, and defaulted field records.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Successful examples cannot prove a closed field correspondence.

property_definitions.label: Mapping totality
property_definitions.semantics: Whether every admitted input returns a target or follows an explicit failure contract.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: One successful call cannot establish totality.

property_definitions.label: Mapping failure contract
property_definitions.semantics: Exact failure behavior for a partial-fallible Mapping.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Thrown exceptions cannot author the portable failure contract.

property_definitions.label: Mapping effect policy
property_definitions.semantics: Closed effect perimeter allowed while transforming shapes.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A before-after snapshot cannot exclude hidden effects.

property_definitions.label: Interface boundary kind
property_definitions.semantics: Authored placement of the exposed boundary.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Public syntax cannot author internal or external meaning.

property_definitions.label: Interface contract identity
property_definitions.semantics: Exact authored identity of the boundary contract.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A native interface name cannot establish canonical identity.

property_definitions.label: Interface exact version
property_definitions.semantics: Exact contract version bound by the realization.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Compatibility cannot be inferred from a version-shaped string.

property_definitions.label: Interface compatibility policy
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed compatibility rules for the exact version.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Matching members do not prove compatibility.

property_definitions.label: Interface exact exposure set
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed exact set of exposed Operation and Query bindings.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus native member observation
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Generic one-callable cardinality is invalid for an Interface.

property_definitions.label: Event tense
property_definitions.semantics: The event names a fact that already occurred.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A past-tense class name is not proof of a durable fact.

property_definitions.label: Event payload contract
property_definitions.semantics: Exact authored payload identity.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Record fields cannot author payload meaning.

property_definitions.label: Event payload version
property_definitions.semantics: Exact version of the event payload.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A version field cannot prove consumer compatibility.

property_definitions.label: Event occurrence identity contract
property_definitions.semantics: Contract that distinguishes one fact occurrence from publication attempts.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Attempt IDs cannot replace occurrence identity.

property_definitions.label: Event durable fact checkpoint
property_definitions.semantics: Exactly one authored checkpoint after which the past fact exists durably.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Construction or publish attempts do not establish a durable fact.

property_definitions.label: Event publication policy
property_definitions.semantics: Exact retry, acknowledgement, and failure policy for publication attempts.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Idempotency evidence cannot inflate into distributed exactly-once delivery.

property_definitions.label: Event consumer contracts
property_definitions.semantics: Exact consumers and their compatible payload contracts.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A call graph cannot author consumers.

property_definitions.label: Operation input contract
property_definitions.semantics: Exact authored input contract.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A parameter signature cannot author Operation meaning.

property_definitions.label: Operation declared reads
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed closed read perimeter.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Observed reads cannot author the allowed set.

property_definitions.label: Operation declared writes
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed closed write perimeter.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Before-after state cannot exclude write-restore.

property_definitions.label: Operation external effects
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed closed external-effect perimeter.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Visible calls cannot exclude hidden or deferred effects.

property_definitions.label: Operation outcome contract
property_definitions.semantics: Exact successful outcomes of the state-changing action.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A returned value alone cannot establish committed outcome.

property_definitions.label: Operation failure contract
property_definitions.semantics: Exact failure outcomes and residues.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Thrown exceptions cannot author portable failure semantics.

property_definitions.label: Operation atomicity contract
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed atomic or compensating effect boundary.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Transaction syntax does not prove the authored atomicity boundary.

property_definitions.label: Operation ordered checkpoints
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed order of guard, write, event, external effect, and outcome checkpoints.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus ordered runtime trace
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A trace corroborates but cannot author order.

property_definitions.label: Operation Rule guard bindings
property_definitions.semantics: Exact Rule identity, invocation, decision use, state version, and controlled effect references.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus dependency and runtime observation
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: An import or inlined predicate cannot author a Rule guard binding.

property_definitions.label: Operation emitted Event bindings
property_definitions.semantics: Exact Event, durable checkpoint, order, and outcome relations.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: An emit call cannot author DomainSpec Event meaning.

property_definitions.label: Operation continuation boundary
property_definitions.semantics: Explicit closure beyond which lazy or deferred effects are separately owned.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Function return cannot prove all lazy work is closed.

property_definitions.label: Owner-resolved expected Enum values
property_definitions.semantics: Closed named-value set supplied by the accountable canonical binding owner.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Expected values must never be inferred from the implementation value set.

property_definitions.label: Owner-authored Enum catalogue reference
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed owner input that fixes member identifiers, language-facing keys, and canonical wire values before implementation observation.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Generated or runtime members cannot author, widen, or replace the catalogue.

property_definitions.label: Implemented Enum values
property_definitions.semantics: Normalized named values observed for a direct unit or derived for a composed unit from total leaf-member fact inputs.
property_definitions.observation_stage: native type observation or composition derivation
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Observed implementation members cannot define the canonical expected set.

property_definitions.label: Implemented Enum member records
property_definitions.semantics: Code-facing key and canonical candidate value pairs observed only at direct representation leaves.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Member keys, declaration order, or source location do not establish canonical Enum meaning.

property_definitions.label: Enum representation composition kind
property_definitions.semantics: Whether a representation owns leaf members directly or derives them through composed_from relations.
property_definitions.owner_route: Enum realization profile plus language adapter owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Composition shape does not change the portable closed value-set meaning.

property_definitions.label: Enum native realization form
property_definitions.semantics: Profile-selected language-native form used to represent the closed owner catalogue.
property_definitions.observation_stage: profile binding plus native type observation
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A native form does not define portable Enum membership or canonical wire values.

property_definitions.label: Enum alias policy
property_definitions.semantics: Two member keys may not identify one canonical wire value.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus native hostile fixture
property_definitions.owner_route: Enum realization profile plus language adapter owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A runtime that tolerates aliases does not make aliases portable or admitted.

property_definitions.label: Enum native extension policy
property_definitions.semantics: Language inheritance, mutation, or runtime construction cannot add members after catalogue closure.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Language extension facilities cannot widen the owner-authored set.

property_definitions.label: Enum domain and wire equality collapse
property_definitions.semantics: A domain member and its raw wire string remain distinct values across the explicit adapter boundary.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Equal textual spelling does not make a raw wire string a domain member.

property_definitions.label: Enum wire emission totality
property_definitions.semantics: Every admitted member has exactly one explicit canonical wire output.
property_definitions.observation_stage: owner catalogue plus runtime round-trip fixtures
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: String conversion or serialization convention does not prove a total explicit adapter.

property_definitions.label: Enum wire parsing fallibility
property_definitions.semantics: Parsing an unknown wire value fails without constructing a member.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A successful known-value parse cannot prove unknown values fail.

property_definitions.label: Enum equality and hash contract
property_definitions.semantics: Language-specific equality and hashing behavior selected without collapsing members into raw wire values.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Hashability or textual equality alone does not establish Enum identity.

property_definitions.label: Enum exhaustiveness requirement
property_definitions.semantics: The selected language protocol must account for every member of the closed owner catalogue.
property_definitions.owner_route: Enum language profile plus provider owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: One successful match or lookup cannot prove complete member coverage.

property_definitions.label: Typed data field count
property_definitions.semantics: Count of value-bearing typed fields exposed by a realized domain concept.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A field count cannot establish Value Object identity or formation.

property_definitions.label: Identity component count
property_definitions.semantics: Count of owner-resolved identity components exposed by the realization.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Implementation equality or naming does not establish DomainSpec identity.

property_definitions.label: Declared transition count
property_definitions.semantics: Count of admitted state transitions carried by the realization.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A transition-shaped method cannot establish a DomainSpec State Machine.

property_definitions.label: Callable input or read-target concept bindings
property_definitions.semantics: Exact ordered concept inputs declared by the accountable binding owner: value inputs for Calculation, explicit decision facts for Policy, and declared read targets for Query.
property_definitions.owner_route: Calculation, Policy, or Query binding owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Function parameters cannot author the portable input concept set.

property_definitions.label: Callable output concept binding
property_definitions.semantics: Exact output concept returned by the admitted callable: a value for Calculation, a strategy identity for Policy, and a declared read-model concept and shape for Query.
property_definitions.owner_route: Calculation, Policy, or Query binding owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A native return type cannot author the portable output concept.

property_definitions.label: Callable effect contract
property_definitions.semantics: Declared effect perimeter: none forbids ambient reads and writes for Calculation and Policy and also forbids Policy strategy execution; declared-read-only permits only the Query read targets named by its descriptor and forbids every write through complete consumption and quiescence.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus independent effect observation
property_definitions.owner_route: Calculation, Policy, or Query descriptor owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Self-issued counts, source syntax, or a before-and-after snapshot cannot prove the declared effect perimeter.

property_definitions.label: Callable dependency contract
property_definitions.semantics: Every admitted dependency enters through the declared perimeter; Policy decision facts are explicit inputs only, and Query may read only exact descriptor-declared targets.
property_definitions.owner_route: Calculation, Policy, or Query descriptor owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A closed-over global or hidden service is not an explicit dependency.

property_definitions.label: Callable failure contract
property_definitions.semantics: Failure outcomes are typed and declared by the descriptor.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus hostile input fixtures
property_definitions.owner_route: Calculation, Policy, or Query descriptor owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A thrown exception cannot author the portable failure contract.

property_definitions.label: Callable result consumption
property_definitions.semantics: The returned value, strategy identity, or Query read-model result is fully consumed before effect observation closes; Query additionally remains observed through cancel, close, dispose, finalizer, and quiescence paths supported by its result form.
property_definitions.owner_route: Calculation, Policy, or Query evidence owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Returning a lazy iterator, future, callback, or finalizer cannot close proof before its effects are observed.

property_definitions.label: Callable provider identity
property_definitions.semantics: Exact provider identity bound to the Calculation, Policy, or Query descriptor.
property_definitions.owner_route: Calculation, Policy, or Query provider owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A matching callable name cannot establish provider identity.

property_definitions.label: Callable provider digest
property_definitions.semantics: Content digest of the exact provider implementation under observation.
property_definitions.owner_route: Calculation, Policy, or Query provider owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A provider identifier without matching bytes cannot establish current implementation identity.

property_definitions.label: Callable descriptor digest
property_definitions.semantics: Content digest of the exact owner-authored Calculation, Policy, or Query descriptor.
property_definitions.owner_route: Calculation, Policy, or Query descriptor owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Provider-emitted metadata cannot author the descriptor digest.

property_definitions.label: Current Policy strategy set digest
property_definitions.semantics: Content digest of the exact non-empty owner-authored strategy identity set against which selection is proven.
property_definitions.observation_stage: strategy catalogue binding and membership proof
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A stable catalogue identifier, returned object shape, or executable strategy cannot replace current content-addressed membership evidence.

property_definitions.label: Bound factory extension policy
property_definitions.semantics: A Value Object extension may append exact validators only. An Entity extension may add declared defaults, pure normalization, exact validators, and derived values for already-declared fields, while preserving base validators, identity semantics, concept binding, construction order, and immutability.
property_definitions.observation_stage: factory descriptor and extension graph binding
property_definitions.owner_route: Value Object or Entity factory profile owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Subclassing, wrapping, or accepting a callback does not prove the type-specific additive extension contract.

property_definitions.label: Bound factory validator count
property_definitions.semantics: Count of exact owner-bound RuleImplementation validators fixed at factory definition time in base-before-extension order; Value Object permits zero-or-more while Entity requires one-or-more through its profile contract.
property_definitions.observation_stage: factory descriptor and validator relation binding
property_definitions.owner_route: Value Object or Entity factory descriptor owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A runtime callback count cannot establish validator identity, order, or ownership.

property_definitions.label: Entity base invariants preserved
property_definitions.semantics: Every Entity factory extension preserves inherited validators, typed identity semantics, canonical concept binding, lifecycle stability, construction order, and immutable output.
property_definitions.observation_stage: factory descriptor, extension graph, and hostile construction-route fixtures
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Successful construction through one extension path cannot prove preservation across every admitted route.

property_definitions.label: Entity identity stable across lifecycle
property_definitions.semantics: Every immutable lifecycle snapshot carries the same owner-resolved typed identity and equality and hashing depend on that identity only.
property_definitions.observation_stage: identity resolution plus multi-transition and reconstruction fixtures
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: An unchanged id-looking field, reference equality, or complete-field equality cannot prove stable canonical identity.

property_definitions.label: Entity lifecycle observation mode
property_definitions.semantics: Lifecycle behavior is observed as an ordered sequence of immutable snapshots produced through admitted transition or reconstruction routes.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A mutable object observed at multiple times is not an immutable lifecycle snapshot sequence.

property_definitions.label: Value Object equality mode
property_definitions.semantics: Equality compares every declared component in canonical tuple order after owner-bound normalization, delegating nested values to their exact owned protocols.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus complete per-component equality fixtures
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Reference identity, partial-field equality, or matching serialization bytes cannot establish complete-tuple equality.

property_definitions.label: Value Object hash mode
property_definitions.semantics: Hashing consumes the same canonical normalized complete tuple used by equality and delegates nested values to their exact owned protocols.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus congruent equality and hash fixtures
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Equal hashes do not prove equal values or collision freedom.

property_definitions.label: Value Object immutability mode
property_definitions.semantics: A formed value and every recursively owned nested value component remain immutable through the selected language protocol.
property_definitions.observation_stage: native formation and recursive mutation-hostile fixtures
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Readonly typing, a frozen outer shell, or absence of one setter cannot prove recursive runtime immutability.

relation_definitions.owner_route: Enum realization profile plus language adapter owner
relation_definitions.forbidden_collapse: A composition edge records implementation provenance; it does not create canonical Enum membership, ownership, or authority.
A code dependency is not a DomainSpec semantic relationship.
A guard call does not establish the canonical DomainSpec enforces edge without semantic references.
An endpoint route does not establish canonical DomainSpec exposes semantics by itself.
A function parameter cannot author a Mapping source endpoint.
A function return type cannot author a Mapping target endpoint.
A call or trace cannot author an emits relation, checkpoint, or Event meaning.
Subscription syntax or call-graph reachability cannot author a consumer contract.
A declared implementation edge does not prove runtime adapter correctness.
Native membership does not author the closed semantic state set.
Control flow cannot author transition direction, trigger, guards, or effect intents.
Calling a function does not author Workflow membership.
Source order or incidental trace order does not author semantic precedence.

relation_definitions.owner_route: Workflow and bound concept descriptor owners
relation_definitions.forbidden_collapse: A call target does not author the exact Operation or nested Workflow binding.

relation_definitions.owner_route: Policy descriptor and strategy catalogue owners
relation_definitions.forbidden_collapse: The relation proves a current strategy identity selection binding; it does not prove boolean permission, catalogue authorship, or strategy execution.

relation_definitions.owner_route: Value Object or Entity descriptor and factory owners
relation_definitions.forbidden_collapse: Construction through a function does not establish the exact same-family factory provider, validation order, identity or value semantics, or permission for a cross-family edge.

relation_definitions.owner_route: Value Object or Entity factory and Rule binding owners
relation_definitions.forbidden_collapse: Calling a predicate does not prove an exact owner-bound validator identity, factory-definition binding, or base-before-extension order.

relation_definitions.owner_route: Value Object or Entity factory profile owner
relation_definitions.forbidden_collapse: Inheritance or wrapper composition does not permit cross-family extension, validator removal, identity or value-semantic replacement, mutation, or an extension cycle.
